title: Inconvertibility
summary: INCONVERTIBIL'ITY, noun [from inconvertible.] The quality of not being changeable or convertible into something else; as the inconvertibility of bank notes or other currency into gold or silver.

inlines.v: INCONVERTIBIL'ITY, noun [from inconvertible.] The quality of not being changeable or convertible into something else; as the inconvertibility of bank notes or other currency into gold or silver.
